name: The Tokyo EDITION, Ginza
positioning: Design-led EDITION hotel in Ginza, shaped by Ian Schrager and Kengo Kuma, with an Italian restaurant, a punch bar and a rooftop bar
best_for: Travelers who want a design-focused base in Ginza
Guests who enjoy cocktail bars and a rooftop wine bar

facts.text: The hotel is in Ginza, just off Chuo Street.
The suites have interiors of rich, warm walnut wood with white and marble furnishings.
Connected rooms are available via exterior connecting doors to create a two-bedroom suite.
The hotel has a Penthouse with spacious living and dining areas and a pantry.
Sophie at EDITION is an Italian restaurant on the 14th floor.
The hotel has a 24-hour gym powered by Technogym.
A Black Tea scent created with Le Labo is used in public spaces and bathroom amenities.
A private car to and from Haneda Airport can be arranged by the hotel's guest service before arrival or departure.
The hotel's neighborhood guide lists the Kabukiza Theater in Ginza, which dates back to 1889.

highlights.text: Punch Room is the first bar in Japan to offer an authentic punch bowl ritual, inspired by 19th-century London private clubs.
The hotel's understated luxury was crafted by Ian Schrager and Kengo Kuma.
Lobby Bar has a gold-colored bar surrounded by ivory fabric armchairs and a statement sofa.
The roof-top bar offers natural wines, cocktails and eaux de vie from local wineries and distilleries, surrounded by lush greenery.
Sophie at EDITION has a handmade pasta program at the heart of its menu.

considerations.text: The Roof is a seasonal rooftop destination.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the Ginza location.
